name: USDJPY RSI Divergence + Ichimoku Strategy
description: Daily USDJPY strategy combining RSI divergence detection with Ichimoku Cloud confirmation and two regime filters for long entries. Long entries require bullish RSI divergence (price lower low + RSI higher low), a bullish TK cross (Tenkan above Kijun), price above the Ichimoku cloud, ATR(14) below its 20-period SMA (volatility filter), and rising Senkou Span A (cloud slope filter). Short entries require bearish RSI divergence, bearish TK cross, and price below cloud — no regime filters. Exits on opposing divergence signals. ATR(14)-based stop loss at 3x ATR for long trades. Position sizing at 10% of equity per trade.
source:
# USDJPY RSI Divergence + Ichimoku Cloud Strategy (with Regime Filters)
# Long: Bullish RSI divergence + Bullish TK cross + Price above cloud + ATR filter + Cloud slope filter
# Short: Bearish RSI divergence + Bearish TK cross + Price below cloud (no regime filters)
# Exit: Opposing RSI divergence signal
# Sizing: 10% of equity per trade

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === INDICATORS ===

# RSI (period 14)
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)

# Ichimoku Cloud (Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52)
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(high, low, close)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# ATR (period 14) — used for regime filter and stop loss
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# === RSI DIVERGENCE DETECTION ===
# Detect swing lows: bar where price/RSI made their lowest in 5-bar lookback
is_price_low = lowestbars(period=5)(low) == 0

# Detect swing highs: bar where price/RSI made their highest in 5-bar lookback
is_price_high = highestbars(period=5)(high) == 0

# Capture values at swing points
# Current and previous price lows
current_price_low = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(condition=is_price_low, source=low)
prev_price_low = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(condition=is_price_low, source=low)

# Current and previous RSI at price low points
current_rsi_at_low = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(condition=is_price_low, source=rsi_val)
prev_rsi_at_low = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(condition=is_price_low, source=rsi_val)

# Current and previous price highs
current_price_high = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(condition=is_price_high, source=high)
prev_price_high = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(condition=is_price_high, source=high)

# Current and previous RSI at price high points
current_rsi_at_high = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(condition=is_price_high, source=rsi_val)
prev_rsi_at_high = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(condition=is_price_high, source=rsi_val)

# Bullish divergence: price makes lower low, RSI makes higher low
# Trigger on the bar where a new price low is detected
bull_divergence = is_price_low and (current_price_low < prev_price_low) and (current_rsi_at_low > prev_rsi_at_low)

# Bearish divergence: price makes higher high, RSI makes lower high
# Trigger on the bar where a new price high is detected
bear_divergence = is_price_high and (current_price_high > prev_price_high) and (current_rsi_at_high < prev_rsi_at_high)

# === ICHIMOKU CONDITIONS ===

# TK Cross signals
tk_bull_cross = crossover(tenkan, kijun)
tk_bear_cross = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)

# Price above cloud (above both Senkou Span A and B)
price_above_cloud = (close > senkou_a) and (close > senkou_b)

# Price below cloud (below both Senkou Span A and B)
price_below_cloud = (close < senkou_a) and (close < senkou_b)

# === REGIME FILTERS (Long entries only) ===

# ATR Threshold Filter: block long entries during volatility spikes
# Only allow longs when ATR(14) is below its 20-period SMA
atr_avg = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(atr_val)
atr_filter = atr_val < atr_avg

# Cloud Slope Filter: confirm bullish/expanding cloud
# Only allow longs when Senkou Span A is rising (current > prior bar)
cloud_slope_bull = senkou_a > (senkou_a >> 1)

# === ENTRY LOGIC ===
# Use hold_until to persist divergence and TK cross states
# so all three conditions can align on the same bar

# Hold bullish divergence state until bearish divergence resets it
bull_div_state = hold_until()(enter=bull_divergence, exit=bear_divergence)

# Hold bearish divergence state until bullish divergence resets it
bear_div_state = hold_until()(enter=bear_divergence, exit=bull_divergence)

# Hold TK cross states
tk_bull_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_bull_cross, exit=tk_bear_cross)
tk_bear_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_bear_cross, exit=tk_bull_cross)

# Combined long entry: all original conditions + both regime filters
long_entry = bull_div_state and tk_bull_state and price_above_cloud and atr_filter and cloud_slope_bull

# Combined short entry: original conditions only (no regime filters)
short_entry = bear_div_state and tk_bear_state and price_below_cloud

# === EXIT LOGIC ===
# Exit long on bearish RSI divergence, exit short on bullish RSI divergence
# Wire opposing divergence as the exit via long_and_short_zone logic
# hold_until for position management: hold long until bear divergence, hold short until bull divergence
long_position = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=bear_divergence)
short_position = hold_until()(enter=short_entry, exit=bull_divergence)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_position, short_entry=short_position)

# Position sizing: 10% of equity per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)

# ATR-based stop loss on long trades only (3x ATR from entry)
# Use where() to provide distance only when in a long state; null = no stop for shorts
long_stop_distance = where(long_position, atr_val * 3)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=long_stop_distance)
